source: Copilot CLI local event ledger, filtered by exact agentId
modelSelection: Auto; no fixed model override supplied
notes: Input, cache-read, and cache-write counters retain the ledger semantics; do not assume they are disjoint.
AIU is totalNanoAiu / 1e9; it is not a monetary price.
Request duration is summed request duration, not elapsed implementation time.
Tool transport success does not prove command or model-operation success.
A shell call may batch multiple provider operations; calls are not provider-operation counts.
Coordinator setup, final verification, and publishing are excluded by agent attribution.
